title: ContentReferenceSet
description: Complete, owner-fenced derived relationship coverage for one exact definition and optional publication placement context.

id.description: Platform-assigned application identity; remains stable while this logical reference set is refreshed.

institution_id.description: Institution containing the source and its private relation index.
institution_id.x-reference-scope: Resolve the exact referenced record through its registered owner and prove the same institution and captured version context before write or use.

source_kind.description: Allowlisted source owner record kind; select a fixed resolver, never a client-provided SQL table.

source_version_id.description: Exact source row or revision ID for source_kind. Verify through the registered typed resolver; content equality is not identity.

context_kind.description: Definition extraction or binding of that definition in one exact course placement.

context_key.description: Non-null unique context: literal definition, or lower-case canonical UUID of source_placement_id. It is not an ordinal or URL.

course_version_id.description: Required only for placement binding; exact frozen or staged target course graph.
course_version_id.x-reference-scope: Resolve the exact referenced record through its registered owner and prove the same institution and captured version context before write or use.

source_placement_id.description: Required only for placement binding; its transitive dependency closure must pin the named source version.
source_placement_id.x-reference-scope: Resolve the exact referenced record through its registered owner and prove the same institution and captured version context before write or use.

definition_set_id.description: Required only for placement binding; corresponding current definition set for exactly the same source owner and version.
definition_set_id.x-reference-scope: Resolve the exact referenced record through its registered owner and prove the same institution and captured version context before write or use.

definition_generation.description: Definition generation used for this binding. A newer definition generation invalidates it.

source_digest.description: Canonical owner payload and reference-bearing metadata digest captured for this generation.

graph_digest.description: Required for placement binding; exact publication graph and stable placement-key mapping digest.

projection_profile.description: Versioned reference extraction rules and canonical key encoding profile.

generation.description: Owner-fenced generation. Entries and completion receipt must agree with it.

revision.description: Optimistic token for operational refresh and invalidation.

state.description: Ready means complete coverage including a validated zero-reference result; it does not grant reader authority.

entry_count.description: Exact active generation entry count; zero is meaningful only with ready state.

entries_digest.description: Canonical sorted semantic references digest, including the empty collection when appropriate.

validated_at.description: Server time when captured source, graph and complete entry generation were checked.

last_error_code.description: Fixed non-content-bearing reconciliation code. No raw source text or locators.

x-invariants: Resolve source_kind through a fixed owner registry and verify source_version_id, its institution and current owner digest. No index row authenticates or authorizes source access.

A definition context has no placement fields. A placement context has all placement fields, context_key equals the exact source placement UUID, and its dependency closure pins this exact source version.
Ready means every schema-declared reference is extracted, target checked and represented, including an exact empty set. Published placement sets contain no unresolved required target selectors.

A source or graph mutation must mark this set and affected bindings stale in the same authoritative transaction, or refresh them there. Independent remote transactions require a publication barrier and fail-closed destructive operations.

Do not infer global coverage from the existing rows. Before target deletion, the owner-defined census of all retained reference-bearing source versions must match ready sets or be replaced by an equivalent authoritative locked scan.
Complete generation replacement, row count, entries digest, source token check and ready transition commit atomically. A partial build never advances the ready receipt.
Reference creation and target deletion acquire the same target retention fence. The fence prevents a concurrent new reference from appearing after the deletion census.
Source retirement may remove the set only after authoritative source retention ends. Index rows are rebuildable and cannot remove historic source or target evidence.

A placement refresh verifies the corresponding definition set is ready with matching source digest and projection profile, and pins its generation under the same lock/recheck barrier. Source digest equality alone does not prove definition generation equality.

Definition sets contain placement_selector rows when a stable same-course link remains context-dependent. Exact target_placement_id rows belong only to a placement context; a required placement selector cannot survive as unresolved in that context.

The complete source census includes registered LearningRuleVersion selectors and InteractionDefinition configuration references as well as visible prose. Protected marking/feedback and teacher-only references remain under their source owner disclosure policy.
